verdict.rationale: Zero's self-hosting model (zero-gh-2/6/8/13/16) and its claim that it 'does not track, collect, or sell your data' (zero-gh-15) give users structural control over where data lives and imply deletion is fully within their control, and MCP tools expose explicit email/label delete operations (zero-docs-2, zero-docs-11, zero-docs-13, zero-docs-17). However there is no explicit documentation of a data-retention policy, account/data export or deletion workflow, or GDPR-style controls for the hosted version. Missing for 10: documented retention policy/settings, explicit account-level data deletion process, and independent confirmation of the no-data-collection claim.
